proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ x a r h hr
  rcases lt_or_ge r 0 with hr0 | hr0
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun n => lt_of_lt_of_le hr0 (norm_nonneg _)
  have ha : ‖a‖ ≠ 0 := (lt_of_le_of_lt hr0 hr).ne'
  obtain ⟨f, hf1, hf2⟩ := exists_dual_vector 𝕜 a ha
  have hl : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ‖f (x n)‖) Filter.atTop (nhds ‖f a‖) := (h f).norm
  have hfa : ‖f a‖ = ‖a‖ := by rw [hf2]; simp
  rw [hfa] at hl
  filter_upwards [hl.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hr)] with n hn
  calc r < ‖f (x n)‖ := hn
    _ ≤ ‖f‖ * ‖x n‖ := f.le_opNorm _
    _ = ‖x n‖ := by rw [hf1, one_mul]
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (x : ℕ → E) (a : E) (r : ℝ), (∀ f : StrongDual 𝕜 E, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f (x n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (f a))) → r < ‖a‖ → ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, r < ‖x n‖
